fullDescription: Restrained monochrome card design-system landing page ('Graphite — the quiet card, done right') with no brand color: a sticky paper glass nav, a split hero with a featured card floating over a ghost-card stack, a dark principles marquee, an annotated Anatomy + spec list, a 3-up Gallery with one inverted dark focal card, a five-swatch Tokens palette, and a dark 'copy the component' CTA, all in graphite + platinum + paper, set in Inter with Phosphor icons.
prompt:
## Resumo
A restrained monochrome card design-system landing page ('Graphite — The quiet card, done right') built around one canonical content card on an off-white paper canvas. A sticky translucent paper glass nav sits above a split hero (left: copy + two CTAs + WCAG/responsive trust line; right: a featured card floating over two stacked ghost cards), then a full-bleed dark marquee strip of principles, an Anatomy section (an annotated card beside a four-row spec list), a Gallery (a 3-up grid of card variants including one inverted dark focal card), a Tokens section (a five-swatch palette + a type specimen), a full-bleed dark System CTA band (copy + a 'copy the component' button beside a paper card on dark), and a footer. The entire palette is graphite + platinum + paper, set in Inter, with Phosphor icons.

## Estilo Visual
Build a calm monochrome design-system page with no brand color, all contrast inside a graphite-to-paper greyscale. Configure a Tailwind palette: graphite (950 #1c1c1e, 900 #222224, 850 #28282a, 800 #2c2c2e, 700 #3a3a3c, 600 #48484a), platinum (DEFAULT #c7c7cc, light #d8d8dc, dark #aeaeb2, ghost #86868a), and paper (DEFAULT #f6f5f3, card #fcfbfa, soft #efeeec); plus a custom letterSpacing 'tightest' = -0.045em. Body is bg-paper, text graphite-950, font Inter, antialiased, tracking-tight; ::selection is graphite-950 on paper. Load Inter (weights 300/400/500/600/700) from Google Fonts as the only typeface. Define hairline = 1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.10) and hairline-strong = 1px solid rgba(28,28,30,0.16); a card-shadow = 0 1px 2px rgba(28,28,30,0.04), 0 8px 24px -16px rgba(28,28,30,0.18) and a card-shadow-lg = 0 1px 2px rgba(28,28,30,0.05), 0 24px 60px -28px rgba(28,28,30,0.28). Add a 'grain' texture (radial-gradient rgba(28,28,30,0.025) 1px dots on a 4px tile) for light bands and a 'dot-grid' (radial-gradient rgba(247,246,244,0.10) 1px dots on a 22px tile) for dark bands. Interactions: a 'link-quiet' whose caret/arrow translates 3px right on hover (color transitions to graphite-600); a 'card-rise' that translateY(-4px) with a deeper shadow and a stronger border on hover (transition cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)). Big headings use the tightest tracking; uppercase eyebrows are 12.5px semibold with 0.18em letter-spacing in graphite-600. Icons are Phosphor (ph:*) via Iconify.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky glass nav
A sticky top-0 z-50 header with a translucent bg-paper/80 + backdrop-blur-md and a bottom border at graphite-950/[0.07]. Inside, a max-w-6xl row, h-16, items center, space-between, px-6/lg:px-8. Left: a brand lockup, a 7x7 rounded-md graphite-950 tile holding a paper ph:square-half-bold glyph, then a 15px semibold tracking-tightest wordmark 'Graphite'. Center: a hidden md:flex nav of 13.5px graphite-600 links (Anatomy, Gallery, Tokens, System) that turn graphite-950 on hover, gap-9. Right: a hidden sm:inline 13.5px medium graphite-700 'Sign in' link, then a rounded-lg graphite-950 'Open canvas' button (13.5px medium paper text, px-4 py-2, with a ph:arrow-up-right-bold 13px at 70% opacity, hover:bg-graphite-800), then a md:hidden 9x9 rounded-lg hairline-strong hamburger button (ph:list-bold) that toggles a mobile menu. The mobile menu is a md:hidden bordered drop panel listing the same links at 15px graphite-700; a small script swaps the icon to ph:x-bold and updates aria-expanded when open, and closes on link tap.

### Split hero
A relative overflow-hidden section with the faint 'grain' wash, a max-w-6xl, px-6/lg:px-8, pt-20 pb-16 (lg:pt-28 lg:pb-24), and a bottom hairline. A lg:grid-cols-12 gap-12 row, items-center. LEFT (lg:col-span-6): a rounded-full hairline bg-paper-card pill (12px medium graphite-600 with a 1.5px graphite-950 dot) reading 'Card design system · v2.4'; an h1 in 44px -> sm:58px -> lg:64px semibold tracking-tightest graphite-950, leading-[1.04], reading 'The quiet card,' then a block in platinum-ghost (#86868a) 'done right.'; a max-w-md 16px leading-relaxed graphite-600 subhead; a row of two CTAs, a rounded-lg graphite-950 'Browse the gallery' button (14px medium paper, px-5 py-3, ph:arrow-right-bold, hover:bg-graphite-800) and a rounded-lg hairline-strong bg-paper-card 'See the anatomy' button (14px medium graphite-800 with a ph:ruler, hover:bg-paper-soft); and a trust line of two 12.5px graphite-600 items with ph:check-circle icons ('WCAG AA contrast', 'Responsive by default'). RIGHT (lg:col-span-6): a relative max-w-md (lg:ml-auto) stack: two hidden lg:block absolutely-positioned 'ghost' cards behind (rounded-2xl hairline bg-paper-card at 55% and 80%, offset down/in so they never bleed past the container), and in front the featured card.

### The featured card (signature component)
A relative rounded-2xl hairline-strong bg-paper-card (#fcfbfa) article with p-8 (sm:p-9), the card-shadow-lg, and the card-rise hover. TOP ROW: an inline-flex rounded-md bg-paper-soft pill (11.5px medium uppercase tracking-wide graphite-600) reading 'Featured', and a ph:dots-three-bold (18px platinum-dark) on the right. Then an h3 'Card title' in 22px semibold tracking-tight graphite-950; a 15px leading-relaxed graphite-600 body line ('Some quick example text to build on the card title and make up the bulk of the card's content.'); a 1px graphite-950/[0.08] divider; and a 'link-quiet' 14px semibold graphite-950 'Card link' link with a ph:caret-right-bold caret that nudges right on hover.

### Dark marquee strip + Anatomy
MARQUEE: a full-bleed bg-graphite-950 text-paper band with the dot-grid, a max-w-6xl py-5, holding a centered wrap row of 12.5px tracked principles in platinum/70 with a leading platinum 'Built for restraint', separated by faint '/' dividers: 'Hairline borders', 'Generous padding', 'One quiet CTA', 'Monochrome first'. ANATOMY (id=anatomy): a max-w-6xl, py-20/lg:py-28, bottom hairline. A max-w-2xl intro: a 12.5px semibold uppercase 0.18em-tracked graphite-600 eyebrow 'Anatomy', a 34px -> sm:40px semibold tracking-tightest heading 'Four parts. Nothing wasted.', and a 16px graphite-600 paragraph. Then a lg:grid-cols-12 gap-10 row: LEFT (lg:col-span-7) a rounded-2xl bg-paper-soft/60 hairline inset (p-8/sm:p-12) holding a centered max-w-sm annotated card (rounded-2xl hairline-strong bg-paper-card, card-shadow) with a small absolute -top-3 'Container · radius 16' hairline label pill, a 20px semibold title, a 14.5px graphite-600 body, and a quiet 'Card link' link; RIGHT (lg:col-span-5) a dl divided by graphite-950/[0.08] hairlines, four rows, each a 9x9 rounded-lg bg-paper-soft hairline icon tile (ph:square, ph:text-aa, ph:paragraph, ph:arrow-elbow-down-right) beside a 14px semibold dt + a 13px graphite-600 dd: Container ('Off-white surface, 1px hairline border at 10% graphite, 16px radius, 32px padding.'), Title ('Inter Semibold, 20px, graphite #1c1c1e, tight tracking.'), Body ('Inter Regular, 14.5px, graphite #48484a, 1.6 line height.'), Quiet CTA ('One link, no button. Caret nudges 3px right on hover.').

### Gallery + Tokens
GALLERY (id=gallery): a full-bleed bg-paper-soft/50 band, a max-w-6xl py-20/lg:py-28, bottom hairline. A header row: a max-w-xl block (a 12.5px 0.18em-tracked 'Gallery' eyebrow + a 34px/sm:40px tracking-tightest heading 'One pattern, many jobs.') and a quiet 'View all 24 cards' caret link. Then a mt-12 grid (sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5) of six card-rise cards: five are rounded-2xl hairline bg-paper-card p-7 card-shadow cards, each with a 10x10 rounded-xl icon tile (card 1 = graphite-950 tile with paper ph:stack-simple; the others = bg-paper-soft hairline-strong graphite-800 tiles with ph:ruler / ph:grid-four / ph:circle-half / ph:feather), an 18px semibold title, a 14px graphite-600 body, and a quiet 'Card link'; card 3 is the inverted focal card (rounded-2xl bg-graphite-950 text-paper p-7 card-shadow-lg dot-grid, a bg-paper/10 ph:sparkle tile, paper title, platinum/70 body, platinum-light 'Card link'). TOKENS (id=tokens): a max-w-6xl, py-20/lg:py-28, bottom hairline, a lg:grid-cols-12 gap-12 row: LEFT (lg:col-span-5) a 'Tokens' eyebrow + a 34px/sm:40px tracking-tightest heading 'A palette you can count on one hand.' + a 16px graphite-600 paragraph; RIGHT (lg:col-span-7) a grid-cols-2/sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4 of five swatch cards (rounded-xl hairline bg-paper-card card-shadow, each a h-20 color block over a label + a font-mono hex: Graphite #1c1c1e, Graphite 800 #2c2c2e, Platinum #c7c7cc, Paper #f6f5f3, Paper Soft #efeeec) plus a sixth type-specimen tile (a big 28px tracking-tightest 'Aa' + 'Inter · tight').

### Dark System CTA band + footer
SYSTEM CTA (id=system): a full-bleed bg-graphite-950 text-paper relative overflow-hidden band with an absolute dot-grid, a max-w-6xl py-20/lg:py-28, a lg:grid-cols-12 gap-12 items-center row: LEFT (lg:col-span-7) a 34px -> sm:44px semibold tracking-tightest heading 'Ship the card. Skip the noise.' (with a sm:block line break), a max-w-lg 16px platinum/75 paragraph, and a button row, a rounded-lg bg-paper 'Copy the component' button (14px semibold graphite-950, px-5 py-3, ph:copy-simple, hover:bg-platinum-light) and a quiet platinum-light 'Read the docs' caret link; RIGHT (lg:col-span-5) a rounded-2xl bg-paper text-graphite-950 p-8 card-shadow-lg card on the dark band (a 20px semibold 'Card title', a 14.5px graphite-600 body, a 1px divider, a quiet 'Card link'). FOOTER: a bg-paper band, a max-w-6xl py-12, a flex-col -> sm:flex-row items-center justify-between row: the brand lockup (the 7x7 graphite-950 ph:square-half-bold tile + 'Graphite' wordmark), a wrap row of four 13px graphite-600 footer links (Anatomy, Gallery, Tokens, System), and a 12.5px graphite-600 line 'Monochrome by design · 2026'.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Quiet content card: a rounded-2xl off-white (#fcfbfa) surface with a 1px hairline (or hairline-strong) border, generous 28-36px padding, a soft layered card-shadow, an optional 'Featured' pill + overflow-dots header, a tight-tracked title, one line of body, a 1px hairline divider, and exactly one 'quiet' link CTA (no button).

### Componente
Ghost-card stack: two absolutely-positioned rounded-2xl hairline paper cards behind the hero card at 55% / 80% surface opacity, offset down and inset so the featured card looks like the top of a deck (hidden below lg, never bleeding past the container).

### Componente
Inverted focal card: one gallery card flipped to bg-graphite-950 text-paper with a dot-grid texture, a translucent paper/10 icon tile, and a platinum-light link, used to draw a single focal point without breaking the monochrome rule.

### Componente
Quiet link: a button-less text link in graphite-950 with a ph:caret-right-bold (or arrow) icon that translates 3px right on hover while the text fades toward graphite-600.

### Componente
Card-rise hover: cards translateY(-4px) with a deeper shadow and a stronger hairline border on hover, via a cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) transition.

### Componente
Hairline system: 1px borders at 10% graphite (hairline) and 16% graphite (hairline-strong), plus full-width 7%-graphite band dividers, used everywhere instead of heavy boxes.

### Componente
Anatomy spec list: a dl divided by faint hairlines, each row a rounded-lg paper-soft icon tile (Phosphor) beside a semibold term + a small graphite-600 definition, documenting the card's container / title / body / CTA tokens.

### Componente
Token swatch grid: rounded-xl hairline cards each showing a solid color block over a name + a font-mono hex (#1c1c1e, #2c2c2e, #c7c7cc, #f6f5f3, #efeeec), plus an 'Aa' Inter type specimen.

### Componente
Sticky glass nav with mobile menu: a sticky top-0 z-50 bg-paper/80 + backdrop-blur-md header with a hairline bottom border, a square-half brand mark, a graphite 'Open canvas' button, and a hamburger that toggles a bordered mobile menu (icon swaps to ph:x, aria-expanded updates).

### Componente
Dark dot-grid bands: full-bleed graphite-950 sections (a thin marquee principles strip and a System CTA band) carrying a faint paper dot-grid texture and platinum-toned text.

## Notas Especiais
No-brand-color discipline: the entire system is graphite (950 #1c1c1e through 600 #48484a) + platinum (#c7c7cc, light #d8d8dc, dark #aeaeb2, ghost #86868a) + paper (#f6f5f3 body, #fcfbfa card surfaces, #efeeec soft fills); all contrast lives inside that greyscale, with zero accent hue. One typeface only, Inter (300-700, via Google Fonts), with a custom 'tightest' (-0.045em) tracking on big headings and 0.18em uppercase eyebrows. The look is built from restraint: 1px hairlines (10% / 16% graphite) instead of heavy boxes, generous padding, soft layered card-shadows, a faint radial-dot 'grain' on light bands and a 'dot-grid' on the dark bands, and 'quiet' button-less links whose caret nudges right on hover. Icons are Phosphor (ph:*) via Iconify. Copy is human with zero em-dashes ('The quiet card, done right.', 'Ship the card. Skip the noise.', 'A palette you can count on one hand.'). All card titles / body are sample copy so the prompt ships with no bundled assets; the reusable value is the quiet monochrome card composition (hairline + generous padding + one quiet CTA + ghost-card stack + inverted focal variant) and the graphite/platinum/paper no-accent system, not the words.

Vertical order: sticky glass nav -> split hero (a 12-col grid: 6-col copy left, 6-col featured card right with ghost cards behind) -> full-bleed dark marquee strip -> Anatomy (a 12-col grid: a 7-col annotated card on a soft inset, a 5-col four-row spec list) -> Gallery on a soft band (a sm:2 / lg:3 column card grid, six cards, one inverted dark) -> Tokens (a 12-col grid: 5-col intro copy, 7-col swatch grid) -> full-bleed dark System CTA band (a 12-col grid: 7-col copy + buttons, 5-col paper card on dark) -> footer. Responsive: the hero and most grids collapse to a single column below lg; nav center links and the ghost cards hide below md/lg; the gallery is one column on mobile, two at sm, three at lg; a hamburger toggles a mobile menu below md.

special_ui_components.prompt: Quiet content card: a rounded-2xl off-white (#fcfbfa) surface with a 1px hairline (or hairline-strong) border, generous 28-36px padding, a soft layered card-shadow, an optional 'Featured' pill + overflow-dots header, a tight-tracked title, one line of body, a 1px hairline divider, and exactly one 'quiet' link CTA (no button).

Ghost-card stack: two absolutely-positioned rounded-2xl hairline paper cards behind the hero card at 55% / 80% surface opacity, offset down and inset so the featured card looks like the top of a deck (hidden below lg, never bleeding past the container).

Inverted focal card: one gallery card flipped to bg-graphite-950 text-paper with a dot-grid texture, a translucent paper/10 icon tile, and a platinum-light link, used to draw a single focal point without breaking the monochrome rule.
Quiet link: a button-less text link in graphite-950 with a ph:caret-right-bold (or arrow) icon that translates 3px right on hover while the text fades toward graphite-600.
Card-rise hover: cards translateY(-4px) with a deeper shadow and a stronger hairline border on hover, via a cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) transition.
Hairline system: 1px borders at 10% graphite (hairline) and 16% graphite (hairline-strong), plus full-width 7%-graphite band dividers, used everywhere instead of heavy boxes.

Anatomy spec list: a dl divided by faint hairlines, each row a rounded-lg paper-soft icon tile (Phosphor) beside a semibold term + a small graphite-600 definition, documenting the card's container / title / body / CTA tokens.
Token swatch grid: rounded-xl hairline cards each showing a solid color block over a name + a font-mono hex (#1c1c1e, #2c2c2e, #c7c7cc, #f6f5f3, #efeeec), plus an 'Aa' Inter type specimen.

Sticky glass nav with mobile menu: a sticky top-0 z-50 bg-paper/80 + backdrop-blur-md header with a hairline bottom border, a square-half brand mark, a graphite 'Open canvas' button, and a hamburger that toggles a bordered mobile menu (icon swaps to ph:x, aria-expanded updates).
Dark dot-grid bands: full-bleed graphite-950 sections (a thin marquee principles strip and a System CTA band) carrying a faint paper dot-grid texture and platinum-toned text.

structured.special_notes: No-brand-color discipline: the entire system is graphite (950 #1c1c1e through 600 #48484a) + platinum (#c7c7cc, light #d8d8dc, dark #aeaeb2, ghost #86868a) + paper (#f6f5f3 body, #fcfbfa card surfaces, #efeeec soft fills); all contrast lives inside that greyscale, with zero accent hue. One typeface only, Inter (300-700, via Google Fonts), with a custom 'tightest' (-0.045em) tracking on big headings and 0.18em uppercase eyebrows. The look is built from restraint: 1px hairlines (10% / 16% graphite) instead of heavy boxes, generous padding, soft layered card-shadows, a faint radial-dot 'grain' on light bands and a 'dot-grid' on the dark bands, and 'quiet' button-less links whose caret nudges right on hover. Icons are Phosphor (ph:*) via Iconify. Copy is human with zero em-dashes ('The quiet card, done right.', 'Ship the card. Skip the noise.', 'A palette you can count on one hand.'). All card titles / body are sample copy so the prompt ships with no bundled assets; the reusable value is the quiet monochrome card composition (hairline + generous padding + one quiet CTA + ghost-card stack + inverted focal variant) and the graphite/platinum/paper no-accent system, not the words.
